items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: Cy Welge was his great friend at Lake Forest and a drummer.

ctx.x: And also, it's hard for people to realize that Bix, Bix's influence on Chicago was almost entirely through records, because he generally played in Indiana. He very rarely played around Chicago. Cy Welge was his great friend at Lake Forest and a drummer. And they played together a little bit, jobbing dates.
Before he had developed a style or maybe a... Yes. Before he had heard many things.
